title: What we learned from NFL roster cuts: Struggling QBs J.J. McCarthy and Anthony Richardson stay put

sources.title: What we learned from NFL roster cuts: Struggling QBs J.J. McCarthy and Anthony Richardson stay put
sources.description: Initial 53-man rosters revealed five unusually crowded quarterback rooms, uncertain futures for former first-round picks and a frightening new pass-rush pairing in Los Angeles.
